page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries with Hebrew, Syriac and Aramaic script, running head at top, page number top right, no margin notes.

main_text.p: גנזא, גנזי Chald. Thesaurus, repositorium, aerarium, fiscus. Plur. גנזין, גנזיא.
גנח Ethpeh. Syr. ܐܬܓܢܚ Compungi, Commoveri: ܐܬܓܢܚܘ Compuncti sunt in corde suo, Act.2.37.
גנך גוּנְכָא Ch. Stragula, operimentum villosum, Judic.4.19. & 2.Reg.8.15. ubi quidam scribunt per ב.

גנן Ch.&Syr. Protegere, obtegere, obumbrare, inumbrare. Aphel אגּן Idem. Partic. מגין להון Protegit eos, Jesa.27.3. quasi a גן. Item Habitare, Comorari, Johan.1.14. Act.2.26. Ex Ithpeh. Fut. יתגן מאים על יכון Forte proteget vos, Sophon.2.3.
גנונא, גנונא, גננ Thalamus, tabernaculum: Sic Syr. ܒܢܝ ܕܟܐܬܐ Filii thalami, Matth.9.15. Ite Fuscina vel Sagena, juxta alios, Jobi 40.26.
גננתא, גננתא, גנא ܓܢܬܐ Ch.&Syr.Hortus. Plur. גנין, & foemin. גנת, גנן Eccles.2.5. Jesa.65.3.
גנוניתא Ch. Idem. Frequens in Jonathane.
מגנא Ch. Scutum, Clypeus. Plur. מגנין.

גנם גנוסא, גניסא Ch. ܓܢܣܐ, ܓܢܣܐ Syr. ܓܢܘܣ, ܓܢܣܐ Genus, familia, stemma: Generatio, Nativitas: יום גנוסא Dies nativitatis, id est, natalis, Genef.40.20. in Jonath. ܓܢܣܐ ܕܒܢܝܢܫ Genus humanum. Plural. גנוסין, גנוסיא & גנוסין: & foemin. כל גניסת

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Aramaic script transcribed as closely as legible; Syriac forms in the scan are partly illegible and rendered approximately. Marginal numerals in the lower left are illegible.
